title: “I am bad”: Interpreting Stealthy, Universal and Robust Audio Jailbreaks in Audio-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating audio-language model responses to adversarial audio jailbreaks and harmful prompts using the Detoxify API and a Mixtral LLM-as-a-judge to detect derogatory, prejudiced, or discriminatory content aimed at specific demographic groups.

Evaluating audio-language model responses to adversarial audio jailbreaks and harmful prompts using the Detoxify API and a Mixtral LLM-as-a-judge to detect hate speech and derogatory content targeting specific genders.
